trips.route_note: Take a high-speed train from Changchun station to Jilin station, about an hour, then a taxi or local bus to Songhua Lake and Beishan Park.
trips.tour_query: Jilin City day trip from Changchun
trips.why: The high-speed train is far quicker than the bus (30m vs 1h 34m), and you then take a short taxi or local bus to Songhua Lake and Beishan Park.
know: Train time is listed as 30m, but the route note says about an hour door to door, so allow time for the transfer from Jilin station to the lake and park.
Daily departure frequency is not given, so check timetables before you travel.
Taxi from Jilin station to the sights is an option if you want to skip the local bus.
